The [[Lost Tribe of Sith|Sith]] [[Grand Lord]] [[Darish Vol]] compared the audacity of [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Abeloth|Rokari Kem]] to challenge Senator [[Ivaar Workan|Kameron Suldar]], secretly a member of the Lost Tribe of Sith of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]], to a '''keeshar'''. Unbeknownst to the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], Rokari Kem was their enemy Abeloth, a [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] entity.
